field_evidence.guidance: HM Land Registry practice guide 40 supplement 2: preparing plans for HM Land Registry applications
field_evidence.precise_extent_requirement: plan must clearly and precisely show the extent of the land by suitable colouring or edging
field_evidence.scale_requirement: plan must be drawn to a stated scale and show that scale
field_evidence.context_requirement: plan must show sufficient surrounding roads and features to identify position and extent on Ordnance Survey map and/or parent title plan
field_evidence.public_geometry_availability: guidance is public/no-login but does not expose canonical machine-readable parcel geometries or materialized parcel joins
